Opens a field-test SHIP WebSocket sessio: Opens a field-test SHIP WebSocket session to discovered devices where possible.
Starts a local /ship/ endpoint so wallbo: Starts a local /ship/ endpoint so wallboxes and other devices can pair with NexoWatt EOS.
Announce local SHIP service via mDNS: Announce local SHIP service via mDNS
Required when wallboxes or other EEBUS d: Required when wallboxes or other EEBUS devices should discover EOS as local HEMS automatically via _ship._tcp. In EnergyManagementSystem mode this is enforced by the adapter.
Enables CMI, Hello, protocol handshake a: Enables CMI, Hello, protocol handshake and PIN-state handling for field tests.
After SHIP data exchange is ready, the a: After SHIP data exchange is ready, the adapter sends a read-only NodeManagement detailed discovery request. This is not blocked by command dry run.
Name shown by wallboxes during EEBUS/HEM: Name shown by wallboxes during EEBUS/HEMS pairing. The adapter announces this as the local _ship._tcp service instance.
Default is EOS so wallboxes show the sys: Default is EOS so wallboxes show the system as NexoWatt EOS.
Comma-separated EEBUS category numbers. 2 = Energy Management System.
Used for generated SHIP IDs. Replace the: Used for generated SHIP IDs. Replace the placeholder with the real NexoWatt PEN when available.
Leave empty to generate a local certific: Leave empty to generate a local certificate on first start.
Protected/encrypted. Leave empty to gene: Protected/encrypted. Leave empty to generate a local private key on first start.
Auto accept new devices for field testin: Auto accept new devices for field testing
Only for controlled lab tests. New SHIP: Only for controlled lab tests. New SHIP peers are trusted automatically and Hello continues immediately.
Default is off. Commands to untrusted or: Default is off. Commands to untrusted or unknown devices are recorded but not sent.
Records field-test SPINE command payload: Records field-test SPINE command payloads without sending them. Disable only after pairing/data exchange was verified.
May create large states. Enable only for: May create large states. Enable only for troubleshooting.
Pairing name visible on the device: Pairing name visible on the device
This is the name shown by wallboxes, hea: This is the name shown by wallboxes, heat pumps and other EEBUS devices during HEMS pairing. Keep the default NexoWatt EOS unless multiple EOS systems share one network.
Fixed EEBUS product model: EOS. Legacy v: Fixed EEBUS product model: EOS. Legacy values such as EEBUS Adapter are migrated automatically.
Fixed protocol-facing device type: Energ: Fixed protocol-facing device type: EnergyManagementSystem. This identifies NexoWatt EOS as the local HEMS.
Fixed EEBUS installation category 2 = En: Fixed EEBUS installation category 2 = Energy Management System (EMS).
The value 999999 is only a field-test pl: The value 999999 is only a field-test placeholder. Enter the officially assigned NexoWatt IANA PEN before a new production SHIP identity is generated. Changing this field does not replace an already generated SHIP ID.
Stable identifier of this EOS SHIP node. Do not delete or replace it after pairing devices.
Stable Subject Key Identifier derived fr: Stable Subject Key Identifier derived from the local TLS certificate. This is the key shown or entered during EEBUS pairing.
SHA-256 fingerprint of the local TLS cer: SHA-256 fingerprint of the local TLS certificate for diagnostics and verification.
Enable direct §14a API to NexoWatt EOS: Enable direct §14a API to NexoWatt EOS
Forwards EEBUS LPC commands directly to: Forwards EEBUS LPC commands directly to the EOS controller without manual data-point mapping.
Use auto for automatic instance detectio: Use auto for automatic instance detection. A fixed value such as nexowatt-ui.0 is only needed for multiple EOS instances.
When enabled, accepted LPC limits immedi: When enabled, accepted LPC limits immediately trigger a full EOS control cycle.
The regulation command is rejected when: The regulation command is rejected when EOS does not accept it within this interval.
Used only when the CLS peer does not pro: Used only when the CLS peer does not provide a heartbeat timeout. LPC heartbeats are supervised independently of diagnostic polling.
Send effective EOS controller readback t: Send effective EOS controller readback to the CLS box
The final correlated write result is alw: The final correlated write result is always sent after the full EOS control cycle. This option additionally sends the effective LoadControl readback when the cycle succeeds.
